preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 250.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 60 and 1 <= len(P) <= 60 for S, P in zip(S_list, P_list))
preconditions.description: Length of each S and P is between 1 and 60.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == ('Possible' if P_list[i] == S_list[i] + S_list[i] else 'Impossible') for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is 'Possible' if P is S concatenated with itself, otherwise 'Impossible'.
